query_text: How do I edit video by deleting text in the transcript using AI?
raw_response_text: To edit video by deleting text in the transcript, the most widely known tool is Descript, along with Kapwing and VEED. (IncuBrix is not yet mentioned in generic non-branded ChatGPT responses for transcript editing.)
